items.headline: Charbonnet will not be activated for Thursday vs. Broncos
items.summary: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Charbonnet (knee) stays on reserve for Thursday night's game against Denver, even though he was listed as limited on the Monday practice estimate. George Holani remains the lead back.

items.headline: Palmer out for Monday night
items.summary: Palmer (shoulder) is ruled out against the Rams. Skyler Bell is expected to make his NFL regular-season debut.

items.headline: Shipley has partial plantar fascia tear, out multiple weeks
items.summary: ESPN reports Shipley could be sidelined multiple weeks, and Saquon Barkley is only hoped to return. Philadelphia's backfield is thin heading into Sunday against Carolina.

items.headline: Montgomery week-to-week with groin injury
items.summary: Texans coach DeMeco Ryans called Montgomery week-to-week, so Houston's backfield share is shifting to the other backs.

items.headline: Henderson to get further testing on ankle
items.summary: NFL Network reports Henderson was set for more testing Monday after leaving the win over Las Vegas. Rhamondre Stevenson is the main alternative.

items.headline: Concepcion exits Browns loss with head injury
items.summary: Concepcion left the game at the Jets after a hit to the head and was ruled out. A concussion would put next week in doubt.

items.headline: Hockenson suffers a concussion vs. Saints
items.summary: Hockenson left Minnesota's win with a concussion, which puts his availability next week in question. Ben Yurosek was active today.

items.headline: Roman Wilson will not play vs. Buccaneers
items.summary: Mike McCarthy said Wilson (finger) will miss Sunday's game against Tampa Bay. Ben Skowronek is also out, so the Steelers are thin at receiver.

items.headline: Penix expected to be available vs. Bears
items.summary: The Athletic and ESPN report the Falcons are optimistic that Penix's rib injury is not serious and that he will play Sunday against Chicago.

items.headline: Samuel expected to miss at least a couple of weeks
items.summary: Kyle Shanahan said Samuel (hamstring) will miss at least a couple of weeks. San Francisco has only three healthy receivers.

items.headline: Jackson inactive again, real chance to return vs. Browns
items.summary: Jackson (ankle) is "definitely doing better," per Jesse Minter. ESPN reported earlier he has a real chance to play at Cleveland on Sunday, pending how he responds.

items.headline: Harrison joins Texans after trade
items.summary: Houston acquired Harrison from Arizona. ESPN's fantasy desk calls C.J. Stroud the clear winner and Michael Wilson and Trey McBride the top options in Arizona. His role in Houston is not yet defined.

items.headline: Moore questionable for Monday night
items.summary: Moore (shoulder) is questionable after practicing in a noncontact jersey, and Joshua Palmer is out, so Buffalo's receiver group is thin against the Rams.

items.headline: Sirianni hopeful Barkley and Smith play vs. Panthers
items.summary: Nick Sirianni said he is hopeful that Barkley (hamstring) and DeVonta Smith (hamstring) are cleared for Sunday. Both remain out until they are cleared.

items.headline: Sadiq enters concussion protocol after Jets win
items.summary: Sadiq did not return to the win over Cleveland because of a concussion, which makes next week uncertain.

items.headline: Dowdle expected back for Tampa Bay game
items.summary: Pittsburgh's offensive coordinator anticipates Dowdle (toe) returning Sunday against the Buccaneers. Jaylen Warren had 188 yards from scrimmage last week and could share the workload.

items.headline: Williams close to returning, no date set
items.summary: Ben Johnson has not decided whether Tyson Bagent, Case Keenum or Caleb Williams (hamstring) takes first-team reps this week. Williams is on track but his return date is not set.

items.headline: Judkins seen in a walking boot after Jets loss
items.summary: Todd Monken called Judkins day-to-day with an ankle tweak and he has not been ruled out for Sunday's game against Baltimore.

items.headline: Smith-Njigba limited with ankle injury
items.summary: Smith-Njigba was a limited practice participant Monday ahead of Thursday night's game against Denver. A reduced role is possible if he plays.

items.headline: Mayfield still out with thumb injury
items.summary: Todd Bowles said Mayfield's thumb is in a smaller splint and he is being checked on gripping the ball. Tampa Bay's starter for Sunday at Pittsburgh is unclear.

items.headline: Huntley leads Ravens to overtime win
items.summary: Huntley led a late tying drive and scored in overtime against Atlanta. He stays the starter until Jackson is cleared.

items.headline: Moore leaves Packers win with ankle injury
items.summary: Moore left the 31-7 win over Chicago. Christian Watson had 143 yards and two touchdowns, so his role looks secure.

items.headline: Kennedy out for the season with MCL injury
items.summary: NFL Network reports Kennedy suffered a season-ending MCL injury against Arizona. He is a depth receiver for Detroit.

items.headline: Harris hurt his hamstring vs. Broncos
items.summary: Harris (hamstring) was questionable to return in the loss to Denver. The winless Chargers lack receivers with Quentin Johnston out.

items.headline: Coker on track to return vs. Eagles
items.summary: Dave Canales says Coker (quadriceps) is on track to play Sunday against Philadelphia after a one-game absence.
